projectDescription: A lightweight terminal note-taking application that lets you create, search, update, and delete notes from the command line using a colorful Rich-powered interface backed by SQLite.
keyFeatures: Create notes with a title, content, and optional comma-separated tags
List all notes in a Rich-formatted terminal table sorted by newest first
View a single note by ID in a styled panel with full metadata
Update a note's title, content, or tags independently
Delete a note with an interactive confirmation prompt
Full-text search across title, content, and tags with highlighted matches
SQLite-backed persistent storage via SQLAlchemy ORM
Cross-platform support: Windows, macOS, and Linux
